jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Walkover is looking for a Project Manager to manage project planning, execution, team coordination, and timely delivery. The ideal candidate should have strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and manage projects from start to completion.
  • Work in accordance with timelines, priorities, milestones, and deliverables.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Track work progress and ensure timely delivery.
  • Identify and resolve project risks, issues, and dependencies.
  • Conduct regular follow-ups and provide project status updates.
  • Manage priorities and ensure smooth team coordination.
  • Take ownership of project outcomes and deliverables.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in Project Management.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Good planning, execution, and organizational abilities.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Proactive approach with a strong sense of ownership.

jobs.title: Technical Support Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Responsibilities
  • Working in the team of Technical Support Associates and performing well.
  • Research and identify solutions to software and Saas Product queries.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues, including account setup and network configuration and onboarding.
  • Ask customers targeted questions to quickly understand the root of the problem.
  • Talk clients through a series of actions, either via phone, email, meet or chat, until they’ve solved a technical/non-technical query.
  • Properly escalate unresolved issues to appropriate internal teams (e.g. software developers).
  • Provide support to client for product & API related queries.
  • Analysation of the Bug in product based on customer concern.
  • Ensure all issues are properly logged.
  • Prioritize and manage several open queries at one time.
  • Prepare accurate and timely reports for yourself and team.
  • Document technical knowledge in the form of notes and manuals.
  • Maintain jovial relationships with clients.
  • Utilize AI tools for quicker troubleshooting, automation, summarization, and process efficiency.
Qualifications
  • 1-2 years of proven experience in the field of technical support.
  • Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot basic technical queries.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Ability to provide step-by-step technical help, both written and verbal.
  • Understanding of how API works.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools (e.g., AI chatbots, AI troubleshooting assistants, automation tools, or AI-based documentation assistants).
  • Willingness to work in rotational shifts.
Benefits
  • Flexible Work hours.
  • Flat Organization Structure.
  • Contribute to the growth of the product.

jobs.title: FreeSwitch Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🔹 Role Overview:
You will be responsible for developing, customizing, and maintaining VoIP-based solutions
using FreeSWITCH, ensuring high availability, performance, and reliability of real-time
communication systems.
🔹 Key Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain VoIP applications using FreeSWITCH
• Design and implement call routing, IVR, and dialplan logic
• Integrate FreeSWITCH with backend systems and APIs
• Work with SIP, RTP, and WebRTC protocols
• Troubleshoot and resolve call quality and performance issues
• Optimize system performance for scalability and low latency
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams for product enhancements
🔹 Required Skills:
• Strong experience with FreeSWITCH architecture and modules
• Good understanding of SIP, RTP, WebRTC, and VoIP fundamentals
• Experience in Lua / C / JavaScript (any one or more)
• Knowledge of Linux environments and networking concepts
• Hands-on experience with call flows, IVR, and conferencing systems
• Experience with debugging tools like sngrep, Wireshark
🔹 Good to Have:
• Experience with CPaaS or telecom platforms
• Knowledge of Kamailio / Asterisk
• Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP)
• Understanding of scalable distributed systems

jobs.title: Java Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We are looking for a passionate Java Developer to join our team. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of core Java concepts, object-oriented programming, and basic experience in developing or maintaining Java-based applications.

Key Responsibilities

Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code in Java.
Assist in designing, developing, and testing Java-based applications.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and deliver features.
Debug and troubleshoot issues in existing code.
Learn and adapt to new technologies as required.

Required Skills

Solid understanding of Core Java, OOPs concepts, and data structures.
Basic knowledge of Spring / Spring Boot, JDBC, or Hibernate is a plus.
Familiarity with SQL and relational databases.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good communication and teamwork abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or related field from IIT or other top-tier engineering colleges.
Internship or project experience in Java development.

jobs.title: Sales Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a driven and enthusiastic individual to join our team as a Sales Executive. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys interacting with people, understands customer needs, and is motivated to build meaningful business relationships. You will play a key role in driving revenue growth by converting leads, nurturing client relationships, and contributing to a seamless customer experience. If you are proactive, eager to learn, and excited about working in a fast-paced environment, this role offers strong growth and learning opportunities.
Key Responsibilities:-
● Handle sales inquiries via phone, email, or chat in a timely and
professional manner.
● Understand customer needs and requirements to effectively promote products or
services.
● Educate customers on the features, benefits, and pricing of our offerings.
● Use persuasive selling techniques to convert leads into sales.
● Maintain accurate records of interactions with customers in the CRM system.
● Collaborate with other departments, such as marketing and customer support, to
provide a seamless customer experience.
● Meet or exceed monthly sales targets and key performance indicators (KPIs).
● Continuously improve product knowledge and sales skills through training and
self-learning initiatives.
● Handle objections and resolve customer complaints in a diplomatic and
empathetic manner.
● Stay updated on industry trends, competitor offerings, and market dynamics to
adapt sales strategies accordingly.
Qualifications:-
● Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field preferred.
● 6 months+ experience in SaaS sales.
● Must have strong communication and interpersonal skills.
● Ability to actively listen to customer needs and tailor solutions accordingly.
● Basic understanding of sales principles and techniques.
● Excellent time management and organizational skills.
● Proactive and self-motivated with a positive attitude.
● Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
● Proficiency in using CRM software and other sales tools are preferred.
● Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends if required.
● No prior experience required, but a willingness to learn and grow in a
sales-oriented role is essential.
Benefits:-
● In-house product development with a chance to try hands on research and
development.
● New technology, chance to execute your ideas, Working on future products.
● Ample opportunity to learn and grow.
● Attractive employee benefits and amazing work culture.

jobs.title: PHP Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a skilled PHP Developer to join our engineering team and help build scalable, high-performance applications. If you are passionate about programming and eager to work in a collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply. You will work across the full development lifecycle—design, development, testing, deployment—and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable software solutions. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology while delivering exceptional software solutions.
Responsibilities
  • Develop, test, and maintain high-quality PHP applications.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs and integrate with third-party services.
  • Collaborate with frontend teams and integrate user-facing features with server-side logic.
  • Participate in Agile processes (sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives).
  • Write clean, maintainable code and follow best practices, including code reviews and TDD/CI.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize application performance.
  • Work with relational and NoSQL databases (MySQL, SQL, MongoDB).
  • Assist with cloud-based deployments (AWS preferred).
Requirements
  • 2+ years of experience in PHP development.
  • Strong knowledge of PHP frameworks.
  • Good understanding of design patterns, server-side logic, and software engineering practices.
  • Experience with REST APIs, ORMs (SQLAlchemy), and version control (Git).
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies.
  • Comfortable working in Linux environments.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Good to Have
  • Experience with Redis and MongoDB (NoSQL).
  • Familiarity with message queues like RabbitMQ.
  • Exposure to AWS / GCP, Nginx, and server configuration.
  • Understanding of Microservices architecture.
  • Experience with high-traffic or scalable systems.
Benefits
  • Work on in-house product development and R&D projects.
  • Opportunity to explore new technologies and build future-focused products.
  • Strong learning and growth environment.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Responsibilities
  • Plan, design, and execute functional, regression, and integration test cases.
  • Test REST APIs, backend logic, SQL queries, and data flow across microservices.
  • Perform cross-browser and mobile testing for UI/UX validation.
  • Identify, log, and track defects using standard defect-tracking tools with clear documentation.
  • Collaborate with developers and product teams to ensure high-quality releases.
  • Validate production hotfixes, conduct sanity checks, and maintain QA documentation.
  • Stay updated with modern QA practices, especially AI-driven testing workflows.
Requirements
  • Experience in an Agile/Scrum environment.
  • Strong skills in Manual Testing (functional, regression, system testing).
  • Hands-on experience with API Testing using Postman / REST APIs.
  • Good knowledge of SQL and database validation.
  • Experience with cross-browser and mobile app/browser testing.
  • Proficiency with defect tracking tools (preferably ClickUp).
  • Strong analytical and debugging abilities.
  • Ability to leverage AI-based testing tools for improving testing efficiency.
Benefits
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Flat organizational structure with strong ownership opportunities.
  • Opportunity to contribute directly to product growth.
  • Health benefits and ongoing skill-development support.
